column3: “Date” renders name of the day; laid siege specifies leaning against Jerusalem.
“On the fire” supplies the location of the pot.
The statement that no lot has fallen becomes a command not to cast lots.
“Even by the fire” connects fire explicitly to the failed removal.
The cleansing becomes an attempt, and failure to be clean becomes unwillingness.
“I will judge” replaces they will judge you.
“Lips” renders moustache; “mourners” specifies the people whose bread is meant.
“Delight” renders the cherished thing of your soul.
“Among yourselves” renders each to his brother.
“Know that” replaces the opening question; the delight of eyes and lifting of soul are connected as one description.
“Tell you the news” renders making the ears hear.
